mapper.select: SELECT p.price_id, p.event_schedule_id, p.seat_class_id, p.price, sc.class_name FROM tb_price p JOIN tb_seat_class sc ON p.seat_class_id = sc.seat_class_id WHERE p.event_schedule_id = #{eventScheduleId} ORDER BY sc.priority
mapper.insert:

mapper.update: UPDATE tb_price SET seat_class_id = #{seatClassId}, price = #{price}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE price_id = #{id}
